name: serviceops-agent
title: Raasta
description: A human-reviewed LangGraph quote workflow with two usable intake variants, actual GrowthBook assignment, privacy-scoped event recording and locally verified PostHog SDK delivery.
verification: LangGraph, GrowthBook and local PostHog delivery verified
subtitle: Agent workflows, experiments and analytics
imageAlt: Raasta concept artwork: a sculptural branching route made of pale-lilac ceramic, one chosen raised translucent magenta bridge and a small satin-silver compass beside it
limitations: The default planner uses explicit input fields and rules. This is not autonomous model planning. MemorySaver checkpoints last only for the local server process. The handoff records a synthetic event; no real CRM write occurs. The experiment simulation is synthetic. PostHog verification covers SDK serialization and loopback delivery, not a full analytics backend. No causal conversion gain or customer adoption is claimed.

name: raza-mentor
title: Raza Mentor
subtitle: Source-grounded study and practice
description: An original study workbench with source-linked passages, practice questions, review tracking and session exports, using an actual local DeepTutor BM25 retrieval component.
imageAlt: Raza Mentor original purple-and-pink studio concept artwork
limitations: The public page uses a keyword baseline. Local mode uses DeepTutor’s BM25 component, not its full agent platform. No generative tutor, semantic embeddings, real student records or learning-outcome improvements are claimed.

name: agent-release-lab
title: Parakh
description: An inspectable release-gate workbench with Promptfoo checks, recorded local-classifier evaluation and actual offline Opik exact-match/JSON metrics with negative controls.
verification: Promptfoo and actual local Opik metrics
subtitle: AI evaluation and release gates
imageAlt: Parakh concept artwork: a sculptural precision balance with a translucent pink glass cube on one pan and a stack of violet test blocks on the other, a small inspection lens integrated into the base
limitations: Trace checks do not prove factual correctness or authenticate logs. The local model test uses a small synthetic held-out set; it does not establish customer performance. Opik format and equality metrics do not establish semantic correctness; no full Opik backend or model judge was deployed.

name: raza-atlas
title: Raza Atlas
subtitle: A source-linked map of product architecture
description: An interactive architecture explorer using actual local Graphify AST extraction, pinned public source provenance and cycle-safe dependency traversal.
verification: Graphify: 18 nodes, 34 edges, zero model tokens
imageAlt: Raza Atlas original purple-and-pink studio concept artwork
limitations: The example is a four-file public Raasta source snapshot. Static edges do not prove runtime behavior or complete change impact. External references are explicitly represented, and no semantic or LLM pass was run.

name: irha-voice-sandbox
title: Awaaz
description: An independent public sandbox for local speech transcription, service intake, clarification, quote review, and human handoff using fictional records.
verification: Local Whisper transcription and LiveKit toolset
subtitle: Local voice AI sandbox
imageAlt: Awaaz concept artwork: a distinctive satin-silver desk microphone with deep plum housing and three floating pink porcelain acoustic-wave arcs
limitations: A local English synthetic recording was transcribed successfully. The LiveKit Agent class and quote tool were instantiated, but no live room, telephony call, or external booking was tested. The browser microphone and local speech controls depend on browser support. This sandbox is not the commercial irha service implementation.

name: evidence-map
title: Nukta
description: An evidence-first discovery workbench with exact quote validation, editable hypotheses, explicit RICE assumptions, and local LlamaIndex/MiniLM retrieval.
subtitle: Evidence-led product discovery
imageAlt: Nukta concept artwork: a clear glass magnifying lens over three small pale-lilac research cards connected by fine magenta thread and silver pins
limitations: Exact quote matching does not establish logical support for a hypothesis. Keyword grouping and model-backed retrieval are different modes. The sample interviews are fictional, and RICE values start as operator assumptions.

name: serviceops-mcp
title: Rabta
description: An original MCP server exposing typed service-catalog, quote, and job-status tools, verified with actual client/server protocol calls.
subtitle: Typed tools for AI integrations
imageAlt: Rabta concept artwork: three small rounded pale-lilac ceramic modules linked by curved translucent purple cables with precise pink-metal couplings; one connector is visibly joining the modules
limitations: The tools operate only on synthetic records and a fictional price catalog. There is no private CRM, OAuth deployment, scheduling write, or customer messaging integration.

name: datasheet-copilot
title: RF Prism
description: A source-linked technical comparison tool with Docling table extraction, explicit unit normalization, and unknown-value handling.
subtitle: Source-linked technical document AI
imageAlt: RF Prism concept artwork: a striking optical glass triangular prism, a bright pink wave ribbon passing through it and separating into thin violet and blue frequency bands, two blank pale-lilac technical sheets underneath
limitations: The verified document is an original fictional HTML datasheet. PDF conversion is supported by the underlying converter but is not yet validated here. Numeric power filters do not establish engineering suitability, and no Analogic specifications or outcomes are claimed.

name: framebrief-studio
title: Dastaan
description: A brief-to-storyboard studio with editable scenes, timed previews, SRT/SVG exports, and locally verified Diffusers image generation.
subtitle: AI-assisted storyboarding studio
imageAlt: Dastaan concept artwork: a compact stylized dark-plum film projector casting a pink beam, one curling translucent violet film strip with three blank frames, and two small blank storyboard cards
limitations: The default storyboard is a template. Diffusers renders one planning frame at a time; this is not a finished video generator. Visual continuity and production quality need human review. The optional Ollama drafting adapter remains separately configured.

name: private-feedback-triage
title: Ehsaas
description: A local sentiment and semantic-search workbench using quantized Transformers.js models, with separate rule and actual-inference modes.
verification: Actual local sentiment and embedding inference
subtitle: Private on-device feedback intelligence
imageAlt: Ehsaas concept artwork: a frosted violet-glass vessel enclosing three small tactile speech-bubble-shaped pebbles in pink, lilac and cool blue; a polished clear window reveals the conversation within
limitations: The first AI run downloads model/runtime files. Text inference runs on the device. Scores are not calibrated measures of customer importance, and sarcasm or mixed sentiment may be misclassified. Node inference was verified; browser performance varies by device.

name: bilingual-story-archive
title: Riwayat
description: A timestamped story explorer preserving multilingual source text, with local faster-whisper transcription and source-linked search.
verification: Local ASR on original synthetic recording
subtitle: A searchable archive for spoken stories
imageAlt: Riwayat concept artwork: a carefully preserved lilac audio cassette and a small silver tape reel beside an open blank archival notebook, purple paper bookmarks, two delicate pink sound-wave ribbons rising from the tape
limitations: The English recording and supplied bilingual text are fictional fixtures. One local English ASR run does not establish language or dialect accuracy. Automatic translation and real oral-history collection are not claimed.

name: intake-model-lab
title: Zarra
description: A reproducible local BERT/PEFT intent-classification experiment comparing a rule baseline, an unadapted classifier, and a LoRA adapter on a synthetic held-out split.
verification: Actual local LoRA training and inference
subtitle: Small-model adaptation experiments
imageAlt: Zarra concept artwork: a tiny luminous pink seed at the center of an open sculptural neural lattice of satin-silver rods and small violet ceramic nodes; a small precise object that suggests learning and adaptation
limitations: The experiment uses 30 synthetic training examples and 12 synthetic held-out examples. Both rules and the adapter scored 100% on this tiny set. This establishes no benefit over rules and no customer generalization. The unadapted classifier head is newly initialized.
